_comment: GENERATED by scripts/build-client.sh — do not edit. The single measured source for every client-size claim in prose (#2138). Committed because the .gz artifacts are gitignored, so a fresh clone would otherwise have nothing to check against.

shipped.note: The FULL bundle: every module, no chunk loading. What client.min.js serves and what LIVEVIEW_CONFIG['client_bundle'] = 'full' injects. A claim about it may carry <!-- size-claim: full --> (the default marker).

core.note: The default injected bundle (#4007): every module except the chunks below. A page downloads this plus only the chunks it uses. Claims about it need <!-- size-claim: core --> on the line.

unminified.note: A build INPUT, not a deliverable. Claims about it need <!-- size-claim: unminified --> on the line.
